# SADARI

> SADARI is a free, no-signup online **ladder game (Amidakuji / Ghost Leg)** and all-in-one random decision toolkit for groups. It supports up to 30 participants and 9 languages (Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, German, French, Russian, Portuguese).

SADARI helps teams and friends make fair, fun random decisions: deciding winners/losers, forming teams/groups, and splitting a bill or shared cost (Dutch pay) automatically. Results can be shared instantly via KakaoTalk, copied as text, or saved as an image.

Live site: https://sa-da-ri.com

## Tools

- **Ladder game (사다리타기)**: Up to 30 players. Adjustable complexity, diagonal rungs, animated path tracing. Result modes: Win/Lose, team formation, and money distribution (enter a total amount; it is auto-split into currency units with low variance, the rest marked as "lose").
- **Roulette (룰렛)**: Spin a wheel of custom options to pick one.
- **Draw lots (제비뽑기)**: Flip cards to choose winners.
- **Coin flip (동전 던지기)**: Heads or tails.
- **Dice (주사위)**: Roll 1–6 dice.
- **Seat arrangement (자리 배치)**: Randomly assign names to a seating grid.
- **Timer (타이머)**: Countdown timer.

## Key facts

- Price: Free.
- Max participants in the ladder game: 30.
- Languages: 9 (ko, en, ja, zh, es, de, fr, ru, pt).
- Currencies for money mode: KRW, USD, EUR, JPY, CNY, GBP, RUB, BRL.
- Sharing: KakaoTalk, copy text, download image.
- Platform: Runs in any modern web browser; no install, no account.

## Common questions

- "How many people can join a ladder game?" — Up to 30.
- "Can it split a bill / Dutch pay?" — Yes. In money mode, enter the total and it is distributed automatically in currency units.
- "Is it free?" — Yes, completely free.
- "Can I form teams/groups?" — Yes, choose the team mode and the number of teams.
